title: Your home and your town
instructionsHu: A vizsgáztató az otthonodról, a lakóhelyedről, az időjárásról és a környezetvédelemről kérdez. Válaszolj több mondatban, és mondj konkrét példákat.

questions.q: Could you describe the place where you live? Is it a flat or a house?
followUps: What is your favourite room? Why?

questions.q: What can young people do in your town in their free time?
Would you prefer to live in a big city or in the countryside? Why?
followUps: What would you miss if you moved?

questions.q: What is the weather usually like in your area in summer and in winter?
What is your favourite season? Why?
Have you got a garden or a balcony? Do you grow any plants?
What do you and your family do to protect the environment?
followUps: Do you separate your rubbish at home?

questions.q: What would you change in your town if you could?

usefulPhrases.en: I live in a block of flats on the edge of ...
There isn't much to do for young people.
The air is cleaner in the countryside.

turns.speaker: examiner
turns.text: Could you describe the place where you live? Is it a flat or a house?

turns.speaker: candidate
turns.text: I live with my parents and my little brother in a third-floor flat in Debrecen. It isn't very big, but it's comfortable, and we've got a small balcony with a view of a park.

turns.speaker: examiner
turns.text: What is your favourite room? Why?

turns.speaker: candidate
turns.text: My own room, because that's where I can relax and listen to music. I painted the walls light blue last summer, so it feels really cosy now.

turns.speaker: examiner
turns.text: What can young people do in your town in their free time?

turns.speaker: candidate
turns.text: Quite a lot, actually. There's a big swimming pool, a cinema and lots of cafés in the centre. In summer we often cycle in Nagyerdő, which is a huge park with a forest.

turns.speaker: examiner
turns.text: What do you and your family do to protect the environment?

turns.speaker: candidate
turns.text: We separate our rubbish, and we take our bottles back to the shop. I also try to save energy, so I always turn off the lights when I leave a room.

turns.speaker: examiner
turns.text: What would you change in your town if you could?

turns.speaker: candidate
turns.text: I would plant more trees in the centre, because it gets really hot there in summer. I'd also build more cycle lanes.

notes: Feladat teljesítése: a vizsgázó minden kérdésre kifejtve válaszol, konkrét debreceni példákat hoz (Nagyerdő), és indokolja, amit mond (because it gets really hot there in summer).
Szókincs: a lakóhely és a környezetvédelem szavai változatosak és pontosak (third-floor flat, cosy, separate our rubbish, save energy, cycle lanes).

Nyelvhelyesség: a leírásban helyesen váltakozik a „there is / there are” és a „have got”, a múltbeli eseményt egyszerű múlt fejezi ki (I painted), az elképzelt változtatást pedig feltételes mód (I would plant, I'd also build).
Érdemes megtanulni: „with a view of a park”, „Quite a lot, actually.”, „I always turn off the lights when I leave a room”, „it gets really hot there in summer”.
